C45037.observed: What was checked: that the description, part number and quantity boxes behave the same here as they do in Tech View - in particular that a quantity must be entered, and that a part number is optional. What happened: pressing Save with the quantity box left empty did not save; the message "Enter a qty to save this part." appeared and the row stayed open with the typing intact. Filling the quantity in and saving worked - with no part number at all - and the line went from ten parts to eleven with the "Part added" message. So quantity is required and part number is genuinely optional.

C45054.observed: What was checked: that typing a part by hand, without picking one from the catalogue, still works in Full View and marks the part as one that needs chasing up. What happened: parts typed by hand saved normally with the "Part added" message, and the work order's Parts tab shows them with the status "Requested" and no part number against them - which is how the system flags a part that still needs its details filled in. The behaviour is the same as in Tech View.

C45055.observed: What was checked: that when what you type matches no existing part, the list offers to create it as a brand new part, and that choosing this carries your typing into the detailed window. What happened: typing "ZZNEWPART77" into the Part number box - which matches nothing in the catalogue - produced the option "Create ZZNEWPART77 as a new part" at the end of the list. Choosing it opened the "New Part Request" window with ZZNEWPART77 already filled into both the Description and the Part number, so nothing had to be typed twice.
